name: First response acknowledgment
body: Thanks for writing Lumen. I have the thread and will confirm status within the first-response window.

name: Refund acknowledgment
body: We see the duplicate charge. Finance will post a credit memo and I will send the reference once it lands.

name: Scoped MFA reset
body: I can reset MFA for the named contractors only. Please confirm the four emails and I will send a one-hour reset link.

name: Webhook backoff
body: Delivery is honoring Retry-After. I am checking the worker pool and will replay failed events once the 429s clear.

name: DNS still pending
body: The TXT record can take up to 60 minutes to appear. If it is still pending after that, reply with the record value and I will force a recheck.

name: Resolve and survey
body: Marking this resolved on our side. A one-question CSAT will follow. Reply here if anything is still open.
